Name: Caramel Pudding Recipes
Author: itsannette
Description:
[center]It adds three new recipes, you can find them directly in your kitchen. It's widely loved by the Stardew Valley's childrens. You can gift them or bring them as emergency food on your adventures. You might also want to sell them for profit.

♥︎ Update Notes ♥︎
6/29 | removed PyTK from required files

♥︎ New Recipes ♥︎
※ Bunny-shapped Caramel Pudding
※ Caramel Pudding with Cream
※ Classic Caramel Pudding

♥︎ Requirements ♥︎
※ Wildflour's Gourmet Pantry | for some of the recipes. Please download it for the recipe to work. If you use the Wildflour's Mega Pack mod, it can work too since Gourmet Pantry is included there.
※ Json Assets

♥︎ Credits ♥︎
※ [url=http://twitter.com/zeyami_tibbar]Tibbar[/url] | for the original art. I simply redrew and bring it to the game because it's too cute ˚ʚ♡ɞ˚

♥︎ Etc. ♥︎
